purpose: Prove internal-handoff and external-reply draft preparation locally: one internal handoff draft and two external reply drafts are each linked to a sibling-slice Work Item and source evidence and marked draftOnly=true with outboundApproved=false. An unapproved-outbound scenario records a policy-denial receipt (reusing the Story 2.6 failure receipt field set) for an attempted send without approval, with a noOutboundWithoutApproval guard proving no outbound action occurred. An approved-outbound scenario records an explicit approval receipt whose declared scope names exactly one external reply draft, after which that draft alone is marked releasable; the other two drafts stay draft-only. Drafts are prepared but never sent in this slice; any live external send stays receipt-gated and deferred. Receipts here are local contract evidence only.

failureCodeVocabulary.basis: Manifest com_councilreceipt.com_failure_code is a free-text column with no enumerated choice set. Story 2.6 established a local extension pattern naming failure codes with kind, retry allowance, and human-review semantics; this slice reuses that vocabulary shape and adds one Story 3.3 code for the outbound-without-approval denial. Codes are reproducible local-contract identifiers, not tenant enums; adopting them as tenant-wide choice values is a deferred, receipt-gated decision for Epic 2.

codes.definition: An outbound send was attempted on a draft whose outboundApproved flag is false. The send is denied as a policy denial (non-retryable without a policy change or an explicit approval receipt scoping that draft); no external action occurs. This mirrors the Story 2.6 auto_create_policy_denied shape: the affected artifact stays in a draft-only (reviewable) state until a human explicitly approves the outbound scope.

drafts.com_name: Internal handoff draft - ratify Fabric ontology deferral
drafts.rationale: An internal handoff draft is prepared from the Story 1.4 deferral decision (CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-002) for Doug to hand the Fabric ontology projection deferral to Epic 4 planning. The draft is draft-only and not approved for any outbound action; handing it off internally is itself a separate approval-gated step. No external recipient is involved.

drafts.com_name: External reply draft - follow up on mock Outlook message (unapproved)
drafts.rationale: An external reply draft is prepared from the Story 1.3 follow-up (CWI-LOCAL-FOLLOWUP-001) sourced from the mock Outlook message reference. The draft is draft-only and outboundApproved=false. An attempted send of this draft without approval is denied (see CR-LOCAL-OUTBOUND-DENIED-001); the draft stays unreleased and no outbound action occurred.

drafts.com_name: External reply draft - send revised tenant readiness checklist to Priya (approved)
drafts.rationale: A second external reply draft is prepared from the Story 1.4 meeting action (CWI-LOCAL-MEETING-ACTION-001) to send the revised tenant readiness checklist to Priya. Doug explicitly approved the outbound scope for this draft only (see CR-LOCAL-OUTBOUND-APPROVED-001), so outboundApproved=true and releasable=true; the draft remains draft-only (it is eligible to be sent but is not sent in this slice) and the live external send is receipt-gated and deferred. The other two drafts stay draft-only and unreleased; approval of this draft does not release them.

The send is denied as a non-retryable policy denial without an explicit approval receipt scoping this draft; the draft stays draft-only and reviewable. No message was sent and no external system was called. This reuses the Story 2.6 policy-denial receipt shape (attemptedAction, com_failure_code, retryAllowed, humanReviewRequired) so the denial is recorded, not silent.

outOfScopeActions: change any Work Item state group

outboundDenials.denialRationale: An outbound send was attempted on a draft whose outboundApproved flag is false. The send is denied as a non-retryable policy denial; no outbound action occurred and the draft stays draft-only and reviewable.

approvedOutboundScopes.approvedScope: Authorize the outbound send (release) for external reply draft CWD-LOCAL-REPLY-EXTERNAL-002 only.

noOutboundWithoutApprovalProof.proof: CWD-LOCAL-HANDOFF-INTERNAL-001 is an internal handoff draft with outboundApproved=false and releasable=false. No external_action_requested or external_action_completed receipt was emitted for this draft. No approval receipt scopes this draft. Absence of any external-action-verb receipt binding this draft is the negative evidence that no outbound action occurred without approval.

CWD-LOCAL-REPLY-EXTERNAL-001 has outboundApproved=false and releasable=false. An attempted send was denied by CR-LOCAL-OUTBOUND-DENIED-001 (verb policy_denied, result rejected); the denial is recorded, not the send. No external_action_requested or external_action_completed receipt was emitted for this draft. Absence of any external-action-verb receipt binding this draft is the negative evidence that no outbound action occurred without approval.

CWD-LOCAL-REPLY-EXTERNAL-002 has outboundApproved=true and releasable=true after Doug's explicit approval (CR-LOCAL-OUTBOUND-APPROVED-001), but no external_action_requested or external_action_completed receipt was emitted in this slice; the live send is recorded as deferred. The draft became releasable only after approval, so no outbound action occurred without approval. Absence of any external-action-verb receipt binding this draft is the negative evidence that the (deferred) send has not yet occurred.

deferredOutboundActions.deferredAction: Executing the approved outbound send for CWD-LOCAL-REPLY-EXTERNAL-002 (the revised tenant readiness checklist to Priya) is a receipt-backed external action gated to Epic 2; this slice records the approval and releasable flag only and performs no live external send.

Any future send of CWD-LOCAL-REPLY-EXTERNAL-001 requires a separate explicit approval receipt scoping this draft; the policy denial CR-LOCAL-OUTBOUND-DENIED-001 is non-retryable without such an approval. No live external send is performed in this slice.

Any internal handoff execution for CWD-LOCAL-HANDOFF-INTERNAL-001 requires a separate explicit approval receipt scoping the handoff; this slice records the draft only and performs no handoff execution or outbound action.

workItemStateChangesDeferred.deferredUpdate: Any com_state_group move on CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-002 driven by the internal handoff draft requires a new receipt-backed mutation gated to Epic 2 Story 2.3; this slice records the draft only and performs no state change.

Any com_state_group move on CWI-LOCAL-FOLLOWUP-001 driven by the external reply draft or its denial requires a new receipt-backed mutation gated to Epic 2 Story 2.3; this slice records the draft and denial only and performs no state change.

Any com_state_group move on CWI-LOCAL-MEETING-ACTION-001 driven by the approved external reply draft requires a new receipt-backed mutation gated to Epic 2 Story 2.3; this slice records the approval only and performs no state change.
